summary: 20-foot pole platform in the Frank Church Wilderness, constructed in the 1930s, now in ruins; hike-in, and no source describes what remains today.

facts.agency: US Forest Service - Payette National Forest

access.note: Hike-in site in the Frank Church River of No Return Wilderness; no source describes a closure

visit.trail_note: Listed as hike-in by Idaho Fire Lookouts; the sources give no route details

evidence.supports: Frank Church Wilderness location; 20-foot pole platform; constructed in the 1930s
evidence.quote: Located in the Frank Church River of No Return Wilderness, a 20' pole platform was constructed in the 1930s.

evidence.supports: patrol point for the Sheepeater lookout
evidence.quote: Was a patrol point for Sheepeater LO

sources.title: Lemhi Point Fire Lookout Tower
sources.publisher: firelookout.com (Forest Fire Lookout pages by Rex Kamstra)

sources.title: Lemhi Point Lookout - Idaho Fire Lookouts

notes_for_editor: No year for the platform beyond the 1930s, so no built event is recorded. The 'Sheepeater LO' reference is taken as the Sheepeater lookout; the Sheepeater build dates conflict between the NHLR entry (1957 L-4 ground house) and Idaho Fire Lookouts (1934 L-4 cab), and that conflict is not used here. Access is marked public from wilderness land and the hike-in tag; no source says so directly. No photos found.
